Jonathan -

Joe would probably know the answer to your question -- however, he's offline until the middle of next week. I do know that Shiny Server hasn't been tested on pre-release versions of node, though, so it's possible that using an older version will work. On glimmer, we're using version 0.8.21 of node.js.

See here: https://groups.google.com/d/msg/shiny-discuss/QtyZo-Gz6mo/IqGWa_wSJMgJ
